concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-002 (Power analysis ≥ 50 complete sessions) is not listed in any phase. The plan’s phase table only references SC-001, SC-003, SC-005 for Phase 3, leaving SC-002 uncovered.
FR identifier typo: the table lists "FR-07" while the specification defines this requirement as "FR-007". This inconsistency may cause traceability errors.
